item.description:
A release focused on stability, performance, and visual polish. It comes out of a thorough code audit: memory leaks, potential crashes, licensing errors, and several visual details were fixed. There are no big new features — this is a release to make Glow run smoother and lighter.

🎨 Appearance & animations

  • Capsule shadow fixed: on light desktops, capsules showed dark "corner" wedges because the shadow was rectangular and didn't follow the rounded shape. The shadow now traces the exact capsule outline.
  • More precise Glow capsule (Split = Off mode): the capsule height now matches the Classic style to the pixel (it used to inflate by ~1px per edge), and the expand animation no longer "cuts off" partway with 1px jumps.
  • "Minimal" inset level on notch displays: now sits midway between "Disabled" and "Deep," for a gradual progression instead of an abrupt jump.
  • Steadier panel transitions (GlowBar / search): the crossfade when revealing/hiding syncs better, avoiding flicker during the handoff.

🖥️ Multi-monitor

  • Capsules getting stuck hidden with multiple monitors: in multi-display setups, certain animations resolved "the first available screen" non-deterministically and could leave the real capsule hidden on the wrong monitor. Each animation is now anchored to the correct screen.

🖱️ Interaction

  • Show-on-hover failing again after opening the GlowBar: after revealing the GlowBar, the hidden section would stop expanding on hover and only respond to a click on the icon. Fixed.
  • More reliable temporary item show (temp-show): after returning from sleep/standby or opening a popup menu, the temporarily shown item returns to its place correctly instead of getting "lost."

🔑 Licensing

  • Activating offline no longer wipes your trial: previously, a network failure during activation could be mistaken for an invalid key and leave the app blocked or delete an active trial. A network error is now distinguished from a genuinely rejected key.
  • Offline grace period preserved: the "empty" grace message no longer appears after a temporary validation failure.
  • Clearer error messages: a key-storage problem is now reported as "re-enter your key" instead of a misleading "network error."

🧹 Stability & memory

  • Crashes prevented: fixed several cases where the app could abort (panels released at the wrong time) or hang waiting for a response that never arrived.
  • Memory leaks closed: system observers that were never released (screen changes, spaces, launching/quitting apps) now clean themselves up; icon images for apps that have already disappeared are discarded instead of piling up.
  • Proper shutdown on quit: the full cleanup sequence (panels, event monitors, tasks) now actually runs when you exit.
  • Memory pressure is handled more efficiently so it doesn't saturate the main thread.

⚡ Performance

  • Less CPU when moving the mouse across the bar: the cursor position is read once per cycle (previously ~10 times), and expensive "empty space" checks are only evaluated when needed.
  • Less redundant drawing work: re-rendering of shapes and paths is skipped when nothing changes, and animation timers that piled up during fast app-switching were eliminated.
